capabilities: Chat with note content in a right-sidebar panel over a LAN Ollama server
Choose context modes: current note, selection, linked notes, folder, or RAG-retrieved passages
Retrieve relevant vault passages with citations as clickable wikilinks
Run editable slash commands like /summarize and /rewrite
Save conversations as notes or insert responses at the cursor
extras: Requires setting OLLAMA_ORIGINS on the Ollama host for cross-origin streaming; screenshots section is pending; an Architecture section documents the source layout.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an LLM about your notes without sending content to a cloud service.

relations.evidence: chat with your notes using a remote Ollama server over its native chat API

summary: Right-sidebar chat panel that answers questions about your notes using a remote Ollama server, with RAG retrieval across the vault.
